sources.title: PRC Data Security Law, official CAC publication

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.

This law pack does not implement GB/T 22239 MLPS technical controls, sector important-data catalogues, PIPL, export measures or later network-data regulations. Chinese text is authoritative; labels are paraphrases.
